Please keep replies tight (bullet updates, owners, and any blockers). I pasted a one‑pager summary below and attached the latest QBR deck + enablement checklist.

Quick objectives for this thread:
- Confirm readiness by area (GTM, Enablement, Pricing, Docs, Support)
- Surface any open OKR gaps affecting launch metrics (activation, latency, NRR)
- Lock owners and deadlines so I can finalize slides by Friday COB

Owners / asks (reply with status + ETA):
- GTM (owner: laura_bennett) — demo readiness, partner co-sell motion, sales one-pager (ETA?)
- Enablement (owner: stephanie_nguyen) — training schedule, recordings, playbook completion
- Pricing (owner: karthik_iyer) — discount matrix, list price, promo cadence
- Docs (owner: marissa_cole) — quickstart/tutorial, API examples, release notes
- Support (owner: rishi_malhotra) — runbooks, on-call rotations, SLAs for partners

External note: Anna — thanks for joining on this thread. We'll include a partner slide in the QBR; please flag anything you want included.

Attachments: QBR_deck_v3.pptx; enablement-checklist_v1.xlsx

Thanks — short replies please.
